@@U04244@@
down onto rocky flats,
roaring and foaming every which way,
and step by step down into the valley.
What good is heroic resistance to such power?
I find even myself shuddering with dread.

@@U04246@@
I see nothing of these watery lies.
Only human eyes can be deceived.
But it amuses me all the same.
Look at them,
masses of them out there, the fools,
thinking they're drowning, running,
paddling the air like swimmers,
when all the while they’re standing on solid ground.
A madhouse of confusion!

@@U04247@@
(The ravens have returned.)

@@U04248@@
I'll see our exalted Master hears of your industry.
And yet, if you're so minded,
and want to prove masters yourselves,
hurry off to the glowing smithy
where the dwarf folk never tire at hammering
sparks from metal and stone.
Persuade them without fail to give you fire—
brilliant, flashing, sputtering, exploding—
fire such as sparkles in our Master's mind.
Heat lightning from afar,
or the fall of remotest stars,
are common sights on a summer’s night.
But lightning playing in a confusion of shrubbery,
and stars hissing along the moistened earth—
these are sights have power to amaze.
Don’t put yourselves out too much, of course:
ask politely first, and then insist.

@@U04249@@
(The ravens fly off. The display described takes place.)
translation:
@@U04244@@
下降到岩石平坦的地方，
到处都是咆哮和泡沫，
并一步步下入山谷。
英勇抵抗这样的力量有什么好处呢？
我发现连我自己都因恐惧而颤抖。

@@U04246@@
我对这些淡薄的谎言一无所知。
只有人的眼睛才会被欺骗。
但它仍然让我感到有趣。
看看他们，
那里有一大群傻瓜，
以为他们溺水了，逃跑，
像游泳者一样在空中划水，
当他们一直站在坚实的地面上时。
混乱的疯人院！

@@U04247@@
（乌鸦回来了。）

@@U04248@@
我会看看我们尊贵的师父听说过你们的行业。
然而，如果你这么有心，
想要证明自己是大师，
快点去发光的铁匠铺
那里的矮人从不厌倦锤击
金属和石头产生的火花。
说服他们一定会给你火——
辉煌、闪烁、溅射、爆炸——
我们师父的心中如火花般闪烁。
远方的热闪电，
或最遥远星星的坠落，
是夏日夜晚常见的景象。
但闪电在混乱的灌木丛中嬉戏，
星星沿着湿润的大地嘶嘶作响——
这些景色令人惊叹。
当然，不要把自己暴露得太过分：
先礼貌询问，再坚持。

@@U04249@@
（乌鸦飞走了。所描述的显示发生了。）
